description: HTMLRewriter + existing cmark C quirks, without a DOM parser in the experimental rendering path
strategyNotes: Bun onEndTag events bound native analysis scopes. Temporary closing tags are removed before output; anchors retain block-boundary closure. Math-blocking formatting is excluded because formatting reconstruction is unavailable. The broader aggressive variant is evaluated only on the scope corpus to expose regressions.
assessment: Offline HTML AST and lossy semantic comparison; browser layout and XSS safety are not established by these metrics.

securityProbes.assessment: Limited parse5 inspection; not a browser execution or XSS safety guarantee
